info.name: Developer Assessment Platform(v1)
info.description:
## Developer Assessment Platform API — v1

The **Developer Assessment Platform (DAP)** is a multi-role SaaS API that enables **recruiters** to design, publish, and manage technical assessments, and **candidates** to receive invitations, attempt those assessments, and submit their answers — all under the oversight of a platform **admin**.

The API is versioned at `/api/v1` and is configured via the `{{baseUrl}}` collection variable (default: `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`).

---

### Roles

| Role | Description |
|---|---|
| **Candidate** | Registers, verifies their email, receives assessment invitations, and submits answers. |
| **Recruiter** | Creates and manages problems and assessments, invites candidates, and reviews submissions. |
| **Admin** | Oversees the platform: manages users, approves recruiter applications, and reviews audit logs. |

---

### Folders

#### Health
Server liveness check. Use this endpoint to verify the API is up and reachable before running any workflow.

#### Auth
Full authentication lifecycle for all three roles:
- Candidate/Recruiter/Admin registration and login (including Google OAuth)
- Email verification and OTP resend
- JWT token refresh and logout
- Authenticated identity probe (`/me`)

#### Users
Candidate account self-management:
- View and update own profile
- Change password
- Upload a profile avatar

#### Recruiters
Recruiter profile management:
- View and create/update recruiter profile
- Upload company logo

#### Problems
Problem bank management (Recruiter/Admin):
- List, create (MCQ or written), retrieve, update, and soft-delete problems

#### Assessments
Full assessment lifecycle (Recruiter):
- Create, list, retrieve, update metadata, and soft-delete assessments
- Add problem snapshots and reorder/remove assessment items
- Mark an assessment as **READY** for publishing
- Create a Stripe checkout session to publish an assessment
- Invite candidates and list invitations and submissions

#### Invitations
Invitation management for both sides:
- Retrieve an invitation (as invitee or owning recruiter)
- Accept an invitation as a candidate
- Delete a pending invitation as a recruiter
- Start an attempt from an accepted invitation
- List all incoming invitations for a candidate

#### Attempts
Candidate assessment attempt flow:
- Retrieve own attempt (candidate-safe view)
- Submit all assessment answers
- List all own past attempts

#### Submissions
Post-submission evaluation:
- Evaluate pending written-answer submissions (Recruiter/Admin)

#### Payments
Stripe integration:
- Handle incoming Stripe webhook events (requires Stripe CLI signature verification)

#### Admin
Platform administration (Admin only):
- Dashboard summary with platform-wide metrics
- List, retrieve, and change the status of users
- List and retrieve audit logs
- List recruiter applications and approve them

---

### Base URL

`{{baseUrl}}` resolves to `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`

request.description: Initiates the Google OAuth 2.0 login flow. Redirects the user to Google's consent screen. On successful authorization, the platform creates or retrieves the user account and returns a JWT session.
Issues a new JWT access token using a valid refresh token. Call this when the current access token has expired to maintain the session without requiring the user to log in again.
Alias of the refresh endpoint. Issues a new access token using a valid refresh token.

response.name: Refresh token alias — sample

request.description: Invalidates the current session by revoking the refresh token server-side. After calling this endpoint, the user must log in again to obtain a new token pair.
Returns the identity and role of the currently authenticated user based on the provided JWT access token. Useful for confirming the active session and verifying which role is in use.

response.name: Authenticated identity probe

item.description: Handles the full authentication lifecycle for all three platform roles (Candidate, Recruiter, Admin). Covers registration, email verification (OTP-based), standard and Google OAuth login, role-specific login endpoints, JWT access/refresh token management, logout, and an authenticated identity probe to confirm the current session.

item.description: Platform administration endpoints restricted to the Admin role. Provides a dashboard summary with platform-wide metrics, full user management (list, retrieve, change status), audit log access (list and retrieve individual entries), and recruiter application management (list applications and approve them).

item.name: Recently added APIs
item.description: Requests added for password recovery, candidate discovery, invited-candidate status reporting, assessment attendance/pass reporting, invitation acceptance by ID, attempt cancellation, and recruiter rejection.

request.description: Public endpoint. Sends a 15-minute password reset link when the email belongs to an active account. The response is intentionally generic.

response.name: Forgot password — sample

request.description: Public endpoint. Consumes the single-use reset token and revokes existing refresh sessions.

response.name: Reset password — sample

request.description: Approved recruiter only. Lists active, email-verified candidates with pagination and name/email search.

response.name: List candidates for invitation — sample

request.description: Approved recruiter only. Retrieves the eligible candidate profile by UUID.

response.name: Get candidate profile for invitation — sample

request.description: Approved recruiter only. Lists active, email-verified candidates who have at least one non-deleted invitation from the authenticated recruiter. Supports pagination and name/email search.

response.name: List invited candidates — sample

request.description: Approved recruiter only. Returns the candidate profile and each invitation from the authenticated recruiter, including acceptance status, attempt status, score, and evaluated pass/fail result.

response.name: Get invited candidate status — sample

request.description: Approved owner-recruiter only. Use kind=ATTENDED or kind=PASSED to report candidates for an assessment.

response.name: Reject invitation by ID — sample

request.description: Candidate only. Cancels an in-progress attempt and optionally stores answers currently on screen. Use an empty answers array when there are no answers.

response.name: Cancel attempt with current answers — sample

request.description: Admin only. Rejects a pending recruiter application, returns the applicant to candidate status, records an audit event, and sends a rejection email.
